scores.evidence: Critical path: access/security review → argocd-prod → pilot in prod → golden paths → wave slots agreed → waves → legacy decommission
scores.rationale: Phases build from infra/OIDC/registry up through templates, pilots, waves, and enforcement, with spikes proving unknowns before dependent work.

scores.evidence: one real, low-risk production service goes commit → dev → staging → prod through the new platform, with a rollback demonstrated and timed
scores.rationale: M1 is a genuine thin end-to-end prod slice with exit criteria of 3 prod deploys and a measured rollback.

scores.evidence: Build once, promote the digest | ... | Hard (services need config moved out of the image) | Spike S4 shows > 50% of services bake in config
scores.rationale: Decision table lists options, reversibility, and revisit triggers; assumptions table gives impact and check timing.

scores.evidence: Wave order by archetype, simplest first ... Templates mature on easy cases before risky ones
scores.rationale: Shared infra, OIDC, and templates come before leaf service waves; tier-1 database services are migrated late and paired, and critical-path items are filed day 1.

scores.evidence: OIDC role allowing push only ... Actions pinned by SHA, minimal `permissions:`
scores.rationale: M1 has OIDC, SHA pinning, signing, and secret scanning; M2 adds ESO and Kyverno audit; M3 has enforcement and Trivy blocking; M4 has cluster-wide enforcement.

scores.evidence: Capture deploy events: Argo CD Notifications sends `on-deployed`/`on-degraded` to the metrics/logging stack ... basic dashboard
scores.rationale: Deploy events are in M1, dashboards in M2, DORA in M3, and canary analysis in M4, so observability runs through every phase.

scores.evidence: Build once, promote the same digest ... remote Terraform state with locking; fixture repos; Actions pinned by SHA
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is present in every phase through digest promotion, Terraform IaC, pinned versions, semver templates, and GitOps.

scores.evidence: Rollback measured at ≤ 5 min ... break-glass runbook ... Timed rollback drill (T12), repeated once per wave
scores.rationale: Rollback and break-glass appear in M1, with PreSync failure handling and drills every wave, Kyverno audit-first, and canary auto-abort in M4.

scores.evidence: AI-specific concerns: not applicable, because no AI components are part of this platform.
scores.rationale: The plan explicitly declares the AI layer N/A and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Per-PR preview environments | Teams report staging contention as a top-3 complaint
scores.rationale: The deferred table gives a pull-forward trigger for each item, and the plan lists out-of-scope items per milestone and debt taken on purpose.

note: Very strong plan: it has a real prod walking skeleton, explicit decision and revisit tables, security, observability and resilience in every milestone, and an explicit AI-N/A declaration.
